evaluation: Eight original BDD dashcam image diagnostics; all images and all scoped misses retained; not BDD mAP
limitations: Eight selected dashcam frames are diagnostics, not BDD mAP or an automotive accuracy certification.
Legacy BDD box labels can omit or ambiguously label distant/occluded objects; annotation versions are not mixed.
Dataset license allows research/educational/not-for-profit use; general commercial rights are not granted.
All raw images/labels ignored and not redistributed; data-derived report carries the Regents notice.
Camera boxes have image coordinates only, no metric depth, fusion, synchronized vehicle control or signal-color classifier.
data_license: Regents/BAIR BDD data research/educational/not-for-profit terms; see accompanying LICENSE-data.txt. Evaluator code remains Apache-2.0.

freeze.evaluation: All eight new BDD scenes, no BDD-specific calibration or model tuning; fixed pre-inference thresholds
